name: Longstrider

header.Components: V, S, M (a pinch of dirt)

source.attribution: System Reference Document 5.2.1, Wizards of the Coast LLC; CC BY 4.0.

authored_intent: Touch creature; +10-foot Speed for one hour; higher slots add recipients; preserve spent movement when refreshing projections.

rules.text: The target’s Speed increases by 10 feet until the spell ends.
You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.
